title: the hold
caption: The light sets you down inside and goes out, politely, behind you.

hotspots.label: The lit hatch in the floor
The tallest specimen jar
hotspots.text: It was asleep. It is not asleep. It has been in there a very long time and it is glad to see you.

hotspots.label: A console of unfamiliar keys
hotspots.text: The keys light in sequence, wait for an answer you cannot give, and give up. Above you, something unlatches.

hotspots.label: The porthole
hotspots.text: Through it: the field, the treeline, the moon. And your door, still standing in the grass, waiting to be walked back through.

hotspots.label: The opening in the ceiling
hotspots.text: Open now, and dark, and much too high to reach from here.
hotspots.hint: The upper deck. Gated behind the console flag, so it must stay reachable ONLY after the console fires. Behind it: the flight deck, or a nursery, or the place the crew went.

hotspots.label: A doorway further into the craft
hotspots.text: The corridor beyond bends further than the outside of this ship allows.
hotspots.hint: Deeper into the craft, which is bigger inside than out. Behind it: a garden under grow-lights, a corridor that loops, or the hall of doors again seen from a wrong angle.
